correctness.rationale: For all n>=7 the gap bijection is exact; bounded transfers connect fixed-excess gap vectors and the shift-order partial order realizes every global translation unless the state is frozen. Local 3-by-3 move table gives degrees and edge formula. Johnson graph triangle classification excludes top-type triangles, leaving exactly the three-position windows. Direct finite subset enumeration for n<=18 and independent gap enumerator for n<=27 reproduce every stated numerical formula.

evidence: Bonsma, Kaminski and Wrochna, arXiv:1403.0359v1, pp.1-4 distinguish fixed-size independent-set token jumping and token sliding, and do not enforce maximality at intermediate states.
Their generic reachability algorithms do not give this gap-sector degree polynomial, exact triangles, or Eulerian classification.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The paper can give decision procedures for a broader set of configurations, but that graph has extra vertices and edges. A path through it does not establish connectivity when every intermediate matching must be maximal.

evidence: Basavaraju et al., arXiv:1312.5180v1, theorem 1 proves an upper bound and enumeration algorithm for maximal induced matchings of all triangle-free graphs.
Bonsma et al., arXiv:1403.0359v1, theorem classifies reachability algorithms for ordinary independent sets under TJ/TS, not the restricted maximal-independent-set subgraph.
Work on maximal independent sets of ordinary C_n uses gap lengths 2,3, unlike gap lengths 3,4,5 needed for induced matchings.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Neither the broad enumeration bound nor unrestricted fixed-k reachability implies a maximality-preserving exchange graph degree distribution. Ordinary-cycle MIS is a different graph and cannot be substituted for its square. The specific triangle threshold requires the 3/4/5 gap local rule.

evidence: Basavaraju et al. arXiv:1312.5180v1 p.2 identify induced matchings as independent sets in the squared line graph; the line graph of C_n is C_n.
Search results did not exhibit an exact maximal-independent-set reconfiguration theorem for the square of the cycle.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The equivalent formulation is token jumping restricted to maximal independent sets of C_n squared. General all-size-k token jumping may traverse nonmaximal intermediates and does not imply this restricted graph metric.

evidence: Basavaraju et al. arXiv:1312.5180v1 give general enumeration bounds, not the exchange degree table.
No indexed exact degree/girth/triangle table for this configuration graph was retrieved in the targeted queries.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: A pure configuration count would not suffice for novelty. The degree and triangle enumerators and phase transition are finer invariants; this check does not rule out inaccessible tables.

originality.rationale: The strongest inspected primary sources treat either maximal-induced-matching enumeration (Basavaraju et al.) or reconfiguration of independent sets without maintaining maximality (Bonsma et al.). Neither supplies degree, girth, triangle multiplicities or full connectivity of fixed-cardinality maximal induced matchings in cycles. Published mathematical-record comparisons found no implication dominating this full claim; residual unindexed risk remains.
residual_risks: Equivalent gap-exchange and degree/triangle results may appear in unindexed maximal-independent-set or strong-matching Gray-code literature under different terminology.

value.rationale: Natural maximal strong-matching exchange family; determines all fixed-size connected components, frozen configurations, Eulerian and girth regimes, full exact degree spectrum, and formulas for edges and triangles in every size. The first triangle phase has no analogue in the two-state ordinary-cycle maximal-independent-set exchange process and exposes constrained local mobility rather than mere total counts.
